experiences.name: Rome, GA Historic Downtown Art Walk
experiences.description: Explore the vibrant murals, local galleries, and public art installations scattered throughout downtown Rome, GA. Visit the Chieftains Museum and local studios showcasing regional artists along Broad Street.

experiences.name: Farm-to-Table Dining at Local Rome Restaurants
experiences.description: Indulge in the local food scene along Broad Street and the surrounding area, sampling Southern cuisine, farm-fresh ingredients, and regional specialties at highly rated local eateries and bistros in downtown Rome.

experiences.name: Chieftains Museum & Major Ridge Home Tour
experiences.description: Visit this National Historic Landmark just minutes from Chateau Drive, exploring Cherokee history and culture through guided tours of the 1794 plantation home and its rich collection of Native American artifacts and art.

experiences.name: Coosa Valley Farmers Market & Food Tour
experiences.description: Spend a morning at the local farmers market sampling artisan foods, homemade preserves, fresh produce, and baked goods from regional vendors. Pair with a self-guided food tour of nearby cafes and specialty food shops.

experiences.name: Berry College Campus Art & Nature Walk
experiences.description: Explore the stunning Gothic architecture, on-campus art collections, and scenic natural landscapes of Berry College, one of the most beautiful campuses in the US, located just a short drive from Chateau Drive.
experiences.location: Berry College, Mount Berry, Rome GA area
